colors._comment: PRIMITIVE tokens (raw hex) first, then SEMANTIC aliases below that reference them via {token-name}. Never reach for a primitive in component CSS — always go through the semantic layer so a future palette swap only touches this file.

_comment_motion: Durations + easing curves referenced across Block components (accordion, dropdown, navbar, offcanvas). 'spring' curves intentionally overshoot slightly for a tactile feel; 'smooth' curves don't.
_comment_typography: Two-typeface pairing (Galindo/display, Poppins/body) plus the fluid type scale. PROCESS: scale generated via https://utopia.fyi/type/calculator?c=320,16,1.2,1240,20,1.2,5,2,&s=0.75|0.5|0.25,1.5|2|3|4|6,s-l&g=s,l,xl,12 — re-run there and paste back in if the scale ever needs to change.
_comment_space: Fluid space scale. PROCESS: generated via https://utopia.fyi/space/calculator?c=320,16,1.2,1240,20,1.2,5,2,&s=0.75|0.5|0.25,1.5|2|3|4|6,s-l&g=s,l,xl,12 — includes one-up pairs (for transitions between two adjacent steps) and the custom s-l pair from the plan doc.
_comment_layout: Bare layout primitives that don't belong to color/type/space scales. --measure is consumed directly by global-styles.css's typographic-measure rule.
